name: Melink Solar
old_description: Since 1987, Melink Solar has been helping organizations of all sizes create a sustainable future. We became a leader in renewable energy when we built one of the nation’s first LEED Platinum-certified buildings, demonstrating the business case for clean energy. In 2008, we launched our solar division and have since installed over 275 MW across the U.S. Our experience spans projects of all scales, from small commercial installations to large utility-scale arrays, always delivering tailored solutions to meet each customer’s unique needs. Known for our expertise and commitment to quality, we’re proud that so many of our clients return to work with us on future projects. Whether it’s a first-time installation or part of a long-term energy strategy, we’re here to guide you toward a more sustainable future.
about:
Melink Solar, headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio, traces its roots to 1987 when engineer and entrepreneur Steve Melink founded Melink Corporation as an HVAC testing and balancing firm. Melink's invention of the Intelli-Hood variable-speed control system for commercial kitchen ventilation became an industry standard, establishing the company's focus on energy efficiency.

In 2008, the company launched its solar division, Melink Solar, as a full-service commercial EPC (Engineering, Procurement, Construction) provider delivering turnkey projects that encompass system design and engineering, material procurement, construction, and operations and maintenance. The firm has installed more than 275 megawatts and 650,000 panels across the United States, ranging from small commercial rooftops to a 15‑megawatt utility-scale array in Piqua, Ohio, and it owns and operates 10 megawatts of solar capacity.

Melink Solar serves independent power producers, utilities, commercial and industrial facilities, schools and universities, religious organizations, municipalities, government agencies, and non‑profits. Notable clients include the Cincinnati Zoo & Botanical Garden, and the parent corporation has worked with brands such as Apple, Google, Walmart, and Disney.

The company's differentiation stems from its demonstrated commitment to sustainability: its Cincinnati headquarters achieved LEED Platinum and Net Zero Energy status in 2010, among the first 25 buildings worldwide to do so, and Melink Solar tests solar technologies on its own campus before deploying them for customers.

name: Metro Medical Equipment & Supply, Inc.
old_description: Metro Medical Equipment & Supply, established in 1985, has a history of supplying Federal, State and Local Government healthcare facilities with medical equipment and supplies. Whether you are a manufacturer of medical devices or a government contract officer looking to place an order, Metro Medical is here to meet your needs.
about:
Metro Medical Equipment & Supply, Inc. is headquartered in St. Ann, Missouri. Founded in 1985, the company has served federal, state, and local government healthcare facilities for decades. In 2015, Karen Moore assumed ownership and now leads as President and CEO. The business is certified as a woman-owned small business and also operates as a minority-owned enterprise.

The company distributes medical equipment and supplies from established manufacturers to government buyers. Its services include contract management, lead generation, solicitation support, and regulatory compliance guidance (FAR/DFARS/VFAR, BAA/TAA). Metro Medical acts as a bridge between medical device manufacturers and government procurement offices, handling communication, quote preparation, and order fulfillment. The team uses customized software for competitive and historic sales analysis to identify opportunities.

Primary customers are U.S. government healthcare facilities, including VA Medical Centers, military hospitals, Indian Health Service centers, the National Institutes of Health, and other federal, state, and local agencies. Product categories span sports medicine and orthopedics, ophthalmology, trauma and battlefield equipment, cardiology, audiology, hematology, durable medical equipment, and imaging supplies. The firm also represents manufacturers in electromedical apparatus, surgical instruments, and medical wholesale distribution.

Metro Medical emphasizes its expertise in government procurement regulations and contract vehicles, positioning itself as a small-business link that helps manufacturers navigate federal acquisition requirements.

name: Micron Corporation
old_description: High-Mix, Low-Volume Specialists. PCB Assemblies on either a turnkey or consignment basis. New England Electronic Manufacturing Services since 1982. Prototypes, NPI, and Production Builds to IPC-A-610 / J-STD-001.
about:
Micron Corporation has operated from Norwood, Massachusetts since 1982. Founded as a small shop serving local OEMs with precision electronics manufacturing, the company remains family owned and operated, with decisions made close to the shop floor and a focus on long-term customer relationships.

Today Micron provides electronic manufacturing services spanning SMT assembly (including fine-pitch, QFN/BGA, and 01005 placement on a MYCRONIC MY300 line), through-hole and mixed-technology assembly, box build and electromechanical integration, cable and harness assembly, conformal coating and potting, selective soldering, and rework to IPC standards. The shop supports prototypes, new product introductions, and recurring high-mix, low-volume production runs, with inspection capabilities that include 3D AOI and X-ray verification for hidden solder joints. Workmanship follows IPC-A-610 and J-STD-001 Class 2 or 3 as specified.

The company serves OEMs in medical and life sciences, aerospace and defense (ITAR-registered), energy and cleantech, automotive aftermarket, industrial automation, and research and development. Micron also manufactures its own consumer products, the RODAR® II ultrasonic pest repeller and EnergAire® ionizer air purifier, leveraging the same EMS expertise.

Micron emphasizes responsive communication, high-mix flexibility, and a partnership mindset that aims to act as an extension of the customer's team. The family ownership structure enables direct access to project managers and quick decision-making, while documented quality practices, traceability, and supply chain support (turnkey, consignment, or hybrid) help reduce risk on complex assemblies.

Mid America Wire & Cable was founded in 2007 in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The company operates as a wholesale distributor of wire and cable products, serving contractors, original equipment manufacturers, utilities, and industrial buyers across the United States.

The distributor stocks thousands of part numbers across categories that include automotive wire, building wire, hook-up wire, industrial automation and control cable, mil-spec wire, power cable and portable cord, shipboard and marine cable, and transit and locomotive cable. It offers aluminum and copper service entrance capabilities and provides custom and standard part sourcing with same-day shipping on in-stock items. The company operates a nationwide distribution network covering all 50 states.

Mid America Wire & Cable supplies industries such as construction, automotive, telecommunications, electrical, aerospace, healthcare, manufacturing, consumer electronics, renewable energy, and marine. Its customer base includes electrical contractors, OEMs, utility companies, and industrial maintenance departments.

The company emphasizes deep technical expertise paired with an extensive in-stock inventory to help customers specify, quote, and receive the right product quickly. Its differentiation rests on same-day fulfillment, broad product availability, and technical support for product selection.

name: Midcon Cables Company
old_description: Since 1972, Midcon Cables has been an industry-leading cable harness manufacturer specialized in providing high quality, cost effective wiring solutions designed to address the complex electrical performance and packaging requirements of Mil/Aero, industrial and Medical industry applications. Manufactured products and services provided by Midcon include Prototyping and full rate production of Custom/”Built to Print” and molded cable assemblies, RF coaxial connectors/adapters and cable assemblies, Engineering Design and support, product testing and qualification documentation.
about:
Midcon Cables Company was founded in 1972 in North Myrtle Beach, South Carolina. The business is employee-owned and operates facilities in both Missouri and South Carolina.

The company manufactures custom and build-to-print cable assemblies, harnesses, and molded interconnects for demanding applications. Its capabilities include cold molding and over-molding per MIL-M-24041, RF coaxial connector and cable assembly termination, fiber optic cable assemblies (single- and multi-mode), and proprietary organized-wiring technologies such as EverFlex and MicroFlex. Engineering design support, qualification testing, and full documentation are provided alongside prototyping and full-rate production.

Midcon serves the aerospace and defense, industrial, and medical markets. Its products are used on aircraft, ground vehicles, missiles, unmanned systems, rotorcraft, ships, and communications platforms. The company also supports commercial customers with value-added wiring solutions.

Midcon differentiates itself with its EverFlex organized-wiring system, which replaces conventional harnesses and flex circuits with a low-profile, robust alternative that integrates controlled circuit positions and tie-downs. A proprietary quick-set potting compound reduces molding cycle times, and the MicroFlex process uses NC machining to produce ultra-flat ribbon assemblies that can incorporate power, signal, RF, and fiber optic lines. The firm holds AS9100 and NADCAP certifications and is recognized as a preferred supplier for its on-time delivery and quality performance.

name: Millennium Circuits Limited
old_description: Whether you need quick-turn prototypes or scheduled releases of production quantities, you can count on MCL as a value-added partner and printed circuit board (PCB) provider. Since 2005, we have been supplying bare PCBs of various complexities and materials.
about:
Millennium Circuits Limited (MCL) is a printed circuit board supplier headquartered in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Founded in 2005, the company has focused exclusively on bare PCB procurement, positioning itself as a value-added partner for customers ranging from prototype to production volumes.

MCL supplies bare PCBs across a wide range of technologies: rigid, flex, rigid-flex, aluminum, ceramic, heavy copper, RF/microwave, and HDI constructions. Its manufacturing network—both domestic and offshore—supports 1 to 44 layers, a 35:1 drill aspect ratio, maximum panel sizes of 24 by 51 inches, blind and buried vias, micro vias, via-in-pad with conductive or non-conductive fill, controlled impedance, and high copper thicknesses. Surface finish options include ENIG, immersion silver, immersion tin, ENEPIG, HASL, lead-free HAL, OSP, hard gold, soft gold, and selective finishes. The company also provides engineering services such as design-for-manufacturability reviews, design rule checks, stack-up design, impedance modeling, panelization, and cost consulting, along with product life cycle management. MCL reports 1,106 customers served, a 97% on-time delivery rate, and 99.6% of PCBs shipped without defects, backed by over 100 years of combined PCB manufacturing expertise among its team.

The company serves industries including medical, automotive, power and energy, industrial equipment, telecommunications, defense, consumer electronics, marine, test and measurement, and LED lighting. Its customer base comprises contract manufacturers, original equipment manufacturers, and design firms.

MCL differentiates itself through a U.S.-based Customer Concierge team that provides same-day quotes and dedicated support from request through delivery. It maintains strategic, long-term partnerships with vetted manufacturing facilities—selected via a proprietary Vendor IQ evaluation—rather than sourcing from the lowest bidder. The company is ISO 9001 certified (since 2014) and complies with RoHS, REACH, ITAR, IPC-A-600, and IPC-6012 standards, emphasizing a 'right-fit' supplier approach to ensure quality and consistency.

name: Mission Plastics of Ar Inc
old_description: Founded in Ontario, CA, in 1982, Mission Plastics Inc. (MPI) is a full-spectrum custom injection-molding manufacturer for world-class customers in the Medical, Automotive and Commercial industry sectors
about:
Mission Plastics Inc. (MPI) was founded in 1982 in Ontario, California, as a custom injection-molding operation. The company is now headquartered in Nashville, Arkansas, and operates additional facilities in Rancho Cucamonga, California, and Mexicali, Mexico. President Robert Guy leads the organization, which has grown into a full-spectrum manufacturer serving medical, automotive, and commercial sectors.

The company provides precision injection molding, overmolding, insert molding, thin-wall molding, and multi-cavity family molding, supported by in-house tool design, mold making, and automation. Secondary services include plastics and metal CNC machining, assembly, and a full metrology lab with CMM and Keyence laser scanning. The Rancho Cucamonga site houses an on-site tool room and metrology lab, while the Mexicali plant runs 40 molding machines ranging from 55 to 400 tons, with press capacity from 7 to 720 tons and a Class 8 clean room for 7–310-ton presses. Both sites operate 24/7 and handle prototype through high-volume production.

Mission Plastics serves medical device OEMs, automotive suppliers, and commercial product manufacturers. Medical customers have included CareFusion/BD (AirLife respiratory consumables), Safety Syringe (a Beckton Dickinson company), and Parker/Legris. Commercial work spans consumer components, electrical enclosures, and irrigation fittings, with Taral Plastic Container Company cited as a long-term partner.

The company emphasizes scientific molding methodologies, including process capability studies via Minitab, design of experiments, and RJG Master Molder expertise. Its quality system is certified to ISO 13485 for medical devices and ISO 9001, with validation capabilities covering IQ/OQ/PQ and PPAP. A nearshore supply chain model, combining U.S. engineering with Mexican production, is positioned to reduce lead times and logistics risk.

name: Modern Welding Company of Kentucky
old_description: At Modern Welding Company, we take pride in delivering innovative, high-quality tank storage solutions across a wide range of industries. Our Project Stories highlight the depth of our expertise—from advanced fuel storage systems to complex custom fabrication projects. Each project reflects our commitment to engineering excellence, quality craftsmanship, and our ability to meet unique customer requirements. Explore our work to see how we bring precision, reliability, and performance to every solution we deliver.
about:
Modern Welding Company of Kentucky, Inc. operates from Elizabethtown, Kentucky, tracing its roots to June 1932 when John G. Barnard — known as “Mr. Pete” — opened a small job shop in Owensboro. The family-owned business expanded steadily, acquiring plants across the Midwest and South, and by 2022 marked 90 years of continuous operation.

The company manufactures underground and aboveground steel storage tanks, ASME-code pressure vessels, and LPG tanks for flammable and combustible liquids and gases. Its Elizabethtown facility specializes in custom plate work, chute fabrication, wear products, and structural steel fabrication. Modern Welding runs ten tank and vessel fabrication subsidiaries nationwide, two dedicated structural steel plants, and four welding supply stores in Kentucky and Indiana, all linked by a shared information network.

Customers span energy, construction, distillery, agriculture, defense, mining, chemical processing, and petroleum storage. Documented projects include a refinery deisohexanizer tower, UL-142 emergency fuel tanks installed within a hospital footprint, high-capacity fuel storage for a global agribusiness, and bulk propane tanks for poultry facility heating.

Modern Welding positions itself as the largest U.S. supplier of UL-listed steel storage tanks. Its quality program encompasses ASME, NBIC, AWS, AISC, UL, STI, and API standards, and the Elizabethtown plant holds AISC Certified Fabricator status. The company emphasizes domestic production, a regional subsidiary model for faster delivery, and a guaranteed 24-hour quote turnaround.
